profile.name: Eric (eric.exe)
profile.tagline: Hi, I'm Eric — a backend/AI developer with a nursing background. Ask me anything about my education, skills, or projects.

publications.title: Enhancing Students' Critical Evaluation of AI Versus Human-Generated Literature Reviews: Deliberative Pedagogy

details: 12 credits in Python, programming, data analysis, and machine learning
2026 Global Health Innovation Grand Challenge: Grand Finalist, 1 of 8 finalist teams from 48 global submissions
2025 NTU Nursing International Forum: Poster presentation on an AI-driven RAG chatbot for personalized prenatal education

experience.company: Cathay Holdings Digital, Data & Technology Center (DDT)
achievements: Optimized local LLM inference and developed prompt/evaluation harness workflows for enterprise AI use cases; contributed to vendor-independent AI pipeline architecture.
Built a multilingual (EN/ZH/VI) promotional site for an LLM + RAG-powered AI Coach platform.
Maintained and contributed to an existing .NET MAUI cross-platform application, including basic JavaScript/HTML frontend work, code review, and sprint planning.
Customized ERP workflows with SAP ABAP, implemented MySQL stored procedures, and produced technical documentation.
Completed clinical rotations across medical, surgical, and specialty units, with direct experience in nursing assessment, patient education, documentation, and bedside workflow.
Clinical experience informs the design of healthcare software around real users, documentation burden, safety, privacy, and varied levels of digital literacy.

projects.title: AI-Driven Prenatal Education Chatbot
description: Built a bilingual (ZH/EN) RAG chatbot delivered through LINE, using a locally hosted chat model (LM Studio), FAISS vector retrieval over official Taiwanese maternal-health PDFs, and per-user memory for pregnancy week, G/P, and role.

Applied clinical-domain knowledge to structure prenatal education content, reduce hallucination risk, and align responses with government-verified health materials. Capstone prototype presented at the 2025 NTU Nursing International Forum.

projects.title: Low-Cost Long-Term Care Health Information System
description: Open-source prototype HIS for under-resourced long-term care institutions in Taiwan, designed around low-friction workflows for caregivers with varied digital literacy.

Built resident records, medication orders, MAR, intake/output, vitals, PE (Morse/Braden), and SOAP/DAR nursing notes; added an optional AI voice assistant (OpenAI-compatible or local Ollama/LM Studio) that writes care actions directly into records.

faqs.a_en: I'm a backend and AI developer with a B.S. in Nursing from NTU. My background spans local LLM inference, RAG systems, and healthcare software built for real clinical workflows.
faqs.a_zh: 我是後端與 AI 開發者，擁有台大護理學士學位。經歷涵蓋本地 LLM 推論、RAG 系統，以及為真實臨床流程設計的醫療軟體。

faqs.a_en: I build backend systems and AI applications: local LLM inference pipelines, RAG chatbots (EN/ZH/VI), data workflows, and healthcare software. I also maintain existing enterprise codebases.
faqs.a_zh: 我開發後端系統與 AI 應用：本地 LLM 推論流程、RAG 聊天機器人（英／中／越）、資料工作流程，以及醫療軟體。也負責維護既有企業代碼庫。

faqs.q: Tell me about his AI projects
faqs.a_en: My main AI project is a bilingual RAG chatbot for prenatal education using a locally hosted Gemma-3-4B model, FAISS vector search, Flask, and LINE — grounded in government-verified maternal-health content. I also built a multilingual promotional site for an AI Coach platform and maintain a local-inference evaluation harness.
faqs.a_zh: 主要 AI 專案是雙語 RAG 產前教育聊天機器人，使用本地部署的 Gemma-3-4B、FAISS 向量搜尋、Flask 與 LINE，內容基於政府核實的孕產照護資料。另開發多語 AI Coach 推廣站與本地推論評估框架。

faqs.a_en: Clinical rotations taught me how documentation, patient education, safety, and privacy actually work at the bedside. That experience shapes the healthcare software I build — it's designed around real users and real workflows, not abstractions.
faqs.a_zh: 臨床輪轉讓我親見病歷、衛教、安控與隱私如何在病床邊實際運作。這段經驗塑造了我建構醫療軟體的方式——為真實使用者與真實流程設計，而非抽象概念。

faqs.a_en: Core: Python, SQL. Backend/data: SQLite, MySQL, REST APIs, stored procedures, JWT, Node.js/Express. AI/tools: RAG, FAISS, local LLM inference (Gemma via WebLLM), LM Studio, Docker, Git. Working familiarity with JavaScript, C#, SAP ABAP, HTML/CSS.
faqs.a_zh: 核心：Python、SQL。後端/資料：SQLite、MySQL、REST API、stored procedure、JWT、Node.js/Express。AI/工具：RAG、FAISS、本地 LLM 推論（Gemma via WebLLM）、LM Studio、Docker、Git。熟悉 JavaScript、C#、SAP ABAP、HTML/CSS。
